value.answer: Call 911 now. If your child has a prescribed epinephrine auto-injector, use it right away and don't wait to see if this passes. Swelling, hives and a hoarse voice after peanuts are serious signs.
value.triage: Call 911, not 811 - 811 is only for non-urgent advice. Tell them what happened and whether epinephrine was given. Don't drive yourself. Go to the ER even if your child looks better, because symptoms can come back.
